author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: We need to move the risk review hand off and the subsequent consent checks off manual handling entirely. Right now, the chain depends on a person remembering to verify the legal basis before loyalty basket data enters the pipeline. That is fragile. I want the data contracts to enforce those checks automatically. The more of that chain we automate, the sooner we can clear audits without a last minute scramble. Every step that remains done by hand is a point of failure that delays our compliance sign off. I am asking for full automation of the consent validation layer so the system blocks non compliant data at the source.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the level of automation directly leads to faster audit clearance and reduced compliance delays, indicating that doing more than the minimum requested (full automation) would make them happier.
